gbm_population_evidence.quote: The initial diagnosis confirmed by histopathology is World Health Organization WHO grade 4 glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: All patients with recurrent glioblastoma will accept irinotecan and bevacizumab combined with re-radiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: All patients with recurrent glioblastoma will accept irinotecan and bevacizumab combined with re-radiotherapy

coder_notes: Single arm: irinotecan + bevacizumab + re-irradiation in recurrent GBM. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) tested here in a new combination with re-irradiation, so it is coded established_therapy_experiment (not a candidate); irinotecan is then the only non-established antitumour drug (experimental_monotherapy). If the adjudicator treats both drugs as investigational, irinotecan becomes experimental_combination; candidate status of irinotecan is unchanged. The registry lists one combined intervention entry 'Bevacizumab, Irinotecan and Re-radiotherapy', split here by drug. Inclusion says 'WHO grade 4 glioma' with no IDH requirement; population taken from the condition 'Recurrent Glioblastoma'.
